opening.argument: The speaker warns viewers about risky coins and promotion by groups or influencers, describing a rapid-return promise as part of a pump-and-dump pattern, not as an offer to viewers. He explicitly rejects telling viewers which coin to buy. The separate CoinDCX referral offers a brokerage discount, but the evidence does not establish that the discount is deceptive or connected to the coins used in the warning. The description reinforces the educational framing with a warning that crypto products can be highly risky and a disclaimer that neither profits nor protection against losses is guaranteed.
